summary_bullets: Reduce transient macOS Keychain misses from excluding Cursor for long sessions
Make negative reviewer-probe stamps opt-in so transient false results do not persist
Cover Cursor fallback and Codex/Cursor negative-TTL stamp behavior
commit_message:
Harden reviewer auth probes against transient misses

Retry Darwin Cursor keychain preflight reads, add a one-shot live Cursor fallback after preflight exit 2, and route cached false reviewer stamps through a shared negative-TTL policy.

Document the new probe stamp and fallback contracts, and cover retry sequencing, suppressed retry stderr, Cursor fallback, setup failure, and Codex/Cursor negative-stamp behavior in the harnesses.

Inline-triage rule 1: Refresh sibling test contracts while extending the harnesses.
